messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a soft-drain + rolling reboot for az27-rack-09 this Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Targeting low-traffic window. A few GPUs will be cycled for nvlink microcode + NIC firmware. No long downtime expected but some tail latency risk. @oncall please watch latency dashboards :eyes:
jon: How many GPUs are we taking out at a time? any impact to Dedicated pools?
maria: We'll cordon 2 nodes at a time (8 GPUs total across the rack). Dedicated pools get backfill from eu-west and us-east capacity; priority tenants will be migrated first. Expect ~5-7% capacity dip for ~15m in worst case per cohort.
ashley: Can we pre-seed KV cache to reduce cold-request latency during the handover?
maria: Yes — plan includes KV pre-seed after cordon. Runbook step: ``kubectl cordon rack-09-node-{a,b} && ./ops/warm_kv_seed --region=az27 --pods=highprio``. Will do a canary seed on node-a first.
kevin: Any network path changes? last time we saw short bursts on egress link when BGP sessions flapped.
maria: NIC fw update is non-disruptive but we'll do a brief BGP reset per top-of-rack; ops-net will sequence neighbor resets with 30s gaps. infra-bot will post BGP session state.
infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: https://internal.redwood/ops/maint/1791234567 — window Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/az27-rack-reboot.md
jon: Cost question — will we spin up extra burst capacity in us-east? what's the bill estimate?
maria: We'll use pre-warmed burst instances in us-east (8 GPUs) for ~3 hours. Estimated incremental cost ~ $1,200 for the window; finance approved under contingency budget.
nashley: If we see >10% latency regression during warmback, plan to abort and rollback? what's the abort criteria?
maria: Abort if 3 consecutive 1m P95 spikes > 2x baseline or any customer-facing 5xx increase > 0.5%. Rollback steps summarized in runbook (last section). We'll also flag model-serving routes to fallback models in us-east to reduce load.
kevin: I'll be on-call for net; jon you on scheduling and backfill?
jon: Yep. I'll coordinate the burst host spin-up and traffic-drain.
maria: Thanks. Final checklist in thread: 1) pre-seed KV on canary 2) cordon 2 nodes -> drain lowprio tasks 3) apply NIC fw -> bgp reset sequence 4) reboot GPUs -> verify nvlink health 5) uncordon and confirm telemetry 6) post-mortem. Ping me for perms. :thumbsup:
ashley: copy, will watch latency evals and model quality hooks during warmback.
infra-bot: Reminder scheduled in 60m for maintainers.
